name: work-timetracker
title: Work Timetracker
description: A simple yet effective way to log your daily work hours, track your progress, and compare your logged time against standard working hours for any given month. Allows for easy monthly data export.
author: Bellander

commands.name: log-work-hours
commands.title: Log Work Hours
commands.subtitle: Quickly add your worked hours for today or a specific date.
commands.description: Opens a form to log the number of hours worked. Automatically defaults to the current date but allows selection. Supports adding optional notes for each entry. Logged data is saved locally.

commands.name: view-monthly-work-report
commands.title: View Monthly Work Report
commands.subtitle: Check your logged hours, compare with standard hours, and export data.
commands.description: Displays a summary of your logged work hours for a selected month. Compares your total logged hours against the standard working hours for that period. Provides an option to export the detailed log for the month.

commands.name: add-new-project
commands.title: Add New Project
commands.subtitle: Register a new project.
commands.description: Opens a form to add a new project name. Projects are used to categorize time entries.

commands.name: list-projects
commands.title: List Projects
commands.subtitle: View all registered projects.
commands.description: Displays a list of all projects currently stored in the application.

commands.name: project-report
commands.title: Project Report
commands.subtitle: Generate a report for a specific project.
commands.description: Select a project and a time period to see total hours logged.

commands.name: backup-data
commands.title: Backup Data
commands.subtitle: Export all projects and time entries to a file.
commands.description: Saves all your data (projects and time entries) to a JSON file in your Downloads folder.

commands.name: restore-data
commands.title: Restore Data
commands.subtitle: Import data from a backup file.
commands.description: Restores projects and time entries from a selected backup file, overwriting current data.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: View Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Get a quick overview of your work week.
commands.description: Shows hours for today, total for the week, and top projects.

preferences.name: defaultStandardHoursPerDay
preferences.title: Default Standard Hours per Day
preferences.description: Set your standard number of working hours for a full day (e.g., 8). Used to calculate monthly standard hours.

preferences.name: mondayEnabled
preferences.title: Enable Monday.com Integration
preferences.label: Enable integration
preferences.description: Turn Monday.com sync on or off

preferences.name: mondayBoardId
preferences.title: Board ID
preferences.description: ID of the board where items are created

preferences.name: mondayColumnHours
preferences.title: Hours Column ID
preferences.description: Column ID for the number of hours

preferences.name: mondayColumnPerson
preferences.title: Person Column ID
preferences.description: Column ID for assigning the user/persona to the item
